seo.title: Manasi Beauty Saloon | Henna, Packages & Nails in Meena Bazaar, Bur Dubai
seo.description: Manasi Beauty Saloon in Meena Bazaar, Bur Dubai since 2004: bridal and Eid henna, gold facials, waxing, jacuzzi pedicure and nails, with all-day packages from AED 45. 4.7 from 458 reviews.

hero.lede: A women-owned parlour in the heart of Meena Bazaar for bridal and Eid henna, gold facials, waxing, jacuzzi pedicures and nails, with all-day package offers that regulars swear by.

cta_text: Hi Manasi, I'd like to book a package.
address_lines: Manasi Beauty Saloon, Zamzam Main Building
Behind Bhavna Restaurant, Meena Bazaar, Bur Dubai

sections.title: Three packages,

items.name: Package 1–8
items.desc: Gold facial, face bleach, full arms wax, underarms wax, half legs wax, eyebrows, upper lip, forehead. Usually AED 50

items.name: Package 1–11
items.desc: Everything above plus hot oil massage, hair henna and hair wash. Usually AED 80

items.name: Package 1–14
items.desc: Everything above plus manicure, pedicure and hair trim. Usually AED 110

sections.note: From the salon's current offer flyer. Walk-ins accepted; booking recommended on weekends and before Eid.
